scope: Gold engagement / eternity rings currently listed for sale by sellers whose own product or collection page was fetched and quoted during this session.
rules_applied: price_usd is filled ONLY from the price shown on the cited official page on the retrieval date.
weight_g is filled ONLY when the cited page states a weight in grams. Otherwise it is null and flagged W1.
solid_gold_claim holds a verbatim quote. No verdict is issued without a quote.
hallmark_reported / maker_mark_reported are filled ONLY from the seller's own description of the stamp.
No field is ever inferred from karat, price, photo, or 'typical' industry practice.
